{{Terminology Infobox |title = Duskveil |type = Lore }}{{Quote|Once Duskveil is initiated, this place becomes a sealed tomb.|Chase}} ==Description== The '''Duskveil''' Plan is a strategy to seal Startorch Acadeny and all of [[Lahai-Roi]] to protect Solaris as a whole from the Voidmatter Crisis and destruction by the Threnodian [[Aleph-1]]. What Duskveil is and what it does are not elaborated in great detail, but much can be inferred. In essence, Duskveil is an Antivoid Canopy[[Leif]], a kind of [[Void Storm#Voidmatter Barrier|Voidmatter Barrier]] which would seal off both Lahai-Roi and the deeper [[Dimmr Plains]] from the rest of the world to contain Aleph-1 attack for a temporary amount of time.{{Quest|Starlights from Yesterdays}}
'''Lucilla:''' ''We don't know how long Duskveil will hold. No one stays a second longer than necessary.'' It is to be activated after a series of two phases. First, the preparatory phase before the incident proper after rising levels of Voidmatter contamination in the [[Sealed Fissure]].[[Report on Recent Conditions at the Sealed Fissure in the Dimmr Plains]] All students and personnel, including the [[Roya Tribe|Roya]], would be evacuated to the surface of the Frostlands and across the sea via ships and escape pods already commissioned. During the Stridergate Incident, [[the Black Shores]] offered evacuation assistance as well. Second, it would be elevated to its activated phase after the failure to reinforce the Stridergate and the loss of the [[Exostrider]]. Duskveil would be launched via the Drive Replica, a man made facsimile of the original [[Exostrider#Reactor Drive|Reactor Drive]], which would be launched into the Canopy above Lahai-Roi to sustain the barrier. However, according to [[Leif|Adentus]], Duskveil may not have been activated in time if Aleph-1 attacks had lasted a minute longer. ==Change History== {{Change History|3.3}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==See Also== * [[Mr. Chase's Speech Following the Stridergate Incident (Excerpt One)]] * [[Message on Voidmatter Crisis]] ==Navigation== {{Lore Navbox|Terminology}}
